個性暴躁易怒﹐生氣時會卯起來亂打⚬
en: Irritable and angry. It recklessly starts fights.

zh: 身高九尺八寸﹐力大無窮﹐外型憨厚老實⚬
en: At about 3.2m, it has boundless strength.

zh: 擅長使用拳擊﹐常趁人不注意時﹐給予敵人致命的一拳⚬
en: Good at using punches. Often delivers fatal punches while its victim is unawares.

zh: 全身由橡膠製成﹐即使斷裂也可以立刻再生⚬
en: The whole body is made of rubber, even if broken can immediately regenerate.

zh: 以金剛不壞之身而聞名﹐弱點在眼睛上方⚬
en: He is known for his invincible body and his weakness is above the eyes.

zh: 個性膽小﹐隨時都在尋找可以隨身保護的人⚬
en: He has a timid personality and is always looking for someone to protect.

zh: 出生於青青草原﹐擁有操縱閃電的力量⚬
en:
A grassland crea-

ture who can con-

trol lightning.
notes: Born in the green grassland, he has the power to manipulate lightning.

zh: 性情古怪熱情﹐招式變化莫測﹐常以天地為家⚬
en: Eccentric and passionate nature, unpredictable moves, often with heaven and earth as their home.

zh: 被外星人改造的機械人﹐全身佈滿高科技的武器⚬
en: Transformed by the aliens robot, the whole body is covered with high-tech weapons.

zh: 長年隱居在洞穴中﹐擁有聽聲辨位的能力⚬
en: Long lived in the cave, with the ability to hear the sound of the location.

zh: 怨恨所有事物﹐已經殘暴到見人就殺的地步⚬
en: Resentment of all things, has been brutal to the point of killing people on sight.

zh: 罕見的仙獸﹐傳說中只要見過牠一面就會長生不老⚬
en: Rare immortal beast, legend has it that if you see it once, you will live forever.

zh: 上古時期的生物﹐身體的鱗片已經進化成了尖刺⚬
en: The scales of its body have evolved into spikes.

zh: 口中所噴出的火燄足以熔化所有武器⚬
en: The fire that comes out of its mouth is strong enough to melt all weapons.

zh: 平常是一灘熔岩﹐攻擊時才會現出原形⚬
en: It is usually a puddle of lava, but only when it attacks does it show its original form.

zh: 尾巴上燃燒的火焰是它生命的象徵⚬沒有火苗速度便會減弱⚬
en: The flame on its tail is a symbol of its life. Without fire, its speed will be reduced.

zh: 附身於蠟燭的精靈﹐常被誤認為是鬼影⚬
en: A spirit that possesses a candle and is often mistaken for a ghost.

zh: 仙界煉丹爐幻化而成﹐爐中的高溫可煉出任何上等兵器⚬
en: The high temperature of the furnace can produce any weapon of the highest quality.

zh: 自認為比太陽還重要﹐一直想取代太陽的地位⚬
en: He thinks he is more important than the sun, and has always wanted to take over the position of the sun.

zh: 火系中速度最快者﹐來無影去無蹤⚬
en: The fastest in the fire system, come and go without a shadow.

zh: 常假扮成渡船人﹐卻趁人不注意時﹐將人推入海中⚬
en: He often pretends to be a ferryman, but when people are not paying attention, he pushes them into the sea.

zh: 河豚的弟弟﹐身上擁有無藥可解的劇毒⚬
en: Pufferfish's brother, his body has no music to cure the poison.

zh: 雖然很笨重﹐卻很擅長溜過結滿薄冰的冰河⚬
en: Although very heavy, but very good at slipping through the ice river full of thin ice.

zh: 常在海上製造大海浪﹐是傳說中的大海怪⚬
en: Often in the sea to create big waves, is the legendary sea monster.

zh: 海龍王的軍師﹐能透視人心﹐極具智慧⚬
en: The sea dragon king's army teacher, can see through the human heart, very wise.

zh: 以快速振動臉頰的動作來向後方游動⚬其速度相當的快⚬
en: He swims backward with a quick cheek-vibrating motion. Its speed is very fast.

zh: 當遭遇到危險時會從口中吐出泡泡包振全身﹐並快速滾動﹐逃離現場⚬
en: When in danger, it spits out bubbles from its mouth and rolls quickly to escape.

zh: 每當進入產卵時期﹐金魚王就會從四處齊聚一堂﹐而河川也因此變成金
en: When the spawning period begins, goldfish kings gather from all over, and rivers are also affected by the spawning period.

zh: 專吃海中遊玩的小孩﹐曾拍過大白鯊１﹐２集⚬
en: Specializing in eating children swimming in the sea, has shot the great white shark 1, 2 episodes.

zh: 深愛著太陽神宙斯的女子﹐最後成為了最浪漫的星座象徵⚬
en: The woman who loved Zeus, the sun god, eventually became the most romantic symbol of the constellation.

zh: 覆蓋全身的雜草﹐可以擾亂對方的注意力﹐讓對方感覺瞬間移動的錯覺
en: The weeds that cover the whole body can disturb the attention of the other party and make them feel instantly moved.

zh: 頭頂上的大蘑菇﹐凡是看到的人都會有咬牠一口的慾望⚬
en: The big mushroom on the top of the head, everyone who sees it will have the desire to bite it.

zh: 千年老樹幻化而成的樹精﹐已可以遠離土壤自由移動⚬
en:
A spirit from an

ancient tree, now

roaming free.
notes: Thousands of years old trees are transformed into tree spirits, which can move freely away from the soil.

zh: 鮮艷的外表下﹐藏著尖銳的鋼牙﹐冷不防的從背後咬上一口⚬
en:
Hides steel-sharp

teeth under its

colorful facade.
notes: Under the brightly colored appearance, hidden sharp steel teeth, cold bite from behind.

zh: 尖銳無比的鐮刀﹐據說連石頭都可以砍碎⚬
en: The sharpness is comparable to that of a sickle, and it is said that even stones can be shattered.

zh: 具大的身軀使牠在移動牠的身體時﹐所產生的噪音會傳到很遠處⚬
en: Its large body makes the noise it makes when it moves its body travels a long distance.

zh: 這是生長在沼澤的巨大花朵﹐具有很強的毒性⚬
en: This is a huge flower that grows in the swamp and has a strong poison.

zh: 長得像瓢蟲的怪獸﹐翅膀會產生靜電⚬
en: A monster that looks like a ladybug, and its wings produce static electricity.

zh: 喜歡吃香菇的妖怪﹐常常幻想自己是最頂級的大香菇⚬
en: A monster that likes to eat shiitake mushrooms and often imagines itself to be the top of the line.

zh: 以為會由毛毛蟲進化成美麗的蝴蝶﹐卻只有一對醜陋的翅膀⚬
en: Thought it would evolve from a caterpillar into a beautiful butterfly, but only has a pair of ugly wings.

zh: 仙界據守出入口的仙龍﹐頭上的角具有判別真假的能力⚬
en: The immortal dragon that guards the entrance and exit of the immortal world has the ability to distinguish between the real and the fake by the horns on its head.

zh: 據說在某一時期曾幾乎絕種的星獸﹐僅有少數幸運存活下來⚬
en: It is said that at one time the species was almost extinct, but only a few were lucky enough to survive.

zh: 因眼睛的構造不同﹐有熱感應的功能﹐在黑暗中也能看清楚⚬
en: Because of the different structure of its eyes, it can see clearly in the dark because of its heat-sensing function.

zh: 生氣時引發的沙暴﹐無人能擋﹐連整座山都能搬移⚬
en: When angry, it can cause a sandstorm that no one can stop, and it can even move a whole mountain.

zh: 因有了羽翼﹐所以能在空中自由飛翔﹐數量已相當稀少⚬
en: They can fly freely in the air because of their feathered wings, but their numbers are quite rare.

zh: 傳說中的信差﹐看到牠的蹤跡﹐往往代表惡運的到來⚬
en: Legend has it that when a messenger sees its trail, it means bad luck is coming.

zh: 會發出召喚大風的鳴叫聲﹐揮動雙翼能引起巨大龍旋⚬
en: Will call for the sound of the wind chirping, swinging the wings can cause a huge dragon whirl.

zh: 身體有９０％已被機械化﹐卻因螺絲的生鏽而僵硬的飛行⚬
en: 90% of its body has been mechanized, but it flies stiffly because of the rusted screws.

zh: 張開羽翼能遮蔽天空﹐是風和大地的守護神⚬
en: Open the feathered wings can cover the sky, is the wind and earth's guardian god.

zh: 經改造的翼首龍﹐擁有人工智慧﹐學會設陷阱對付敵人⚬
en: The transformed pterodactyl has artificial intelligence and learns to set traps against enemies.

zh: 擁有著一邊在地底挖掘﹐一邊高速移動的能力⚬
en: With the ability to dig in the ground while moving at high speed.

zh: 常吐出黏答答的泥巴混淆敵人視線﹐並趁機開溜⚬
en: Often spit out sticky mud to confuse the enemy's vision, and take the opportunity to escape.

zh: 集所有礦石精華於頭上的四個角﹐因而獲得強大防禦力⚬
en: Collect all the ore essence in the four corners of the head, thus gaining strong defensive power.

zh: 可以連續不斷丟出岩石攻擊對手﹐弱點在於牠的兩個手臂⚬
en: He can continuously throw rocks to attack his opponents, but his weakness lies in his two arms.

zh: 擅長以腕力在打擊戰中取勝的岩石類怪物⚬
en: A rock-like monster that specializes in winning in combat with its wrist strength.

zh: 堅硬的身軀和遁地的能力﹐能自由的在地底活動⚬
en: Hard body and the ability to disappear into the ground, can move freely in the ground.

zh: 猛裂的撞擊力量﹐似乎連山都打得破的感覺⋯⋯
en: The fierce cracking force of the impact, seems to break even the feeling of the mountain.

zh: 全身覆蓋著鋼鐵一般的殼﹐一般的攻擊是無關痛癢的⚬
en: The whole body is covered with a steel shell, the general attack is not painful.

zh: 總是精力旺盛的它﹐常搬運岩石來打發時間⚬
en: Always energetic, it often carries rocks to pass the time.

zh: 任意使用全身的泥土變化成人形﹐踫到水又化成一灘泥巴⚬
en: At will, it will use the whole body of the mud to transform into a human form, and then turn into a beach of mud when it touches water.

zh: 傳說是遠古時代在西域地方﹐人人所懼怕的紅魔鬼⚬
en: Legend has it that it is a red devil feared by everyone in the western region in ancient times.

zh: 智慧方面異常發達的巨額怪獸﹐而且可靈活地飛行在天空⚬
en: It is a giant monster with exceptional intelligence and can fly in the sky with flexibility.

zh: 守備力及速度相當地高﹐見到有生命的物體會緊追不放⚬
en: It has a very high guard and speed, and will chase after anything that is alive.

zh: 從闇黑之域召喚出來的﹐有著令人十分恐懼的形體⚬
en: It is summoned from the dark domain and has a fearful form.

zh: 經由邪惡的力量而獲得生命﹐緊握著一劈大斧頭來自衛⚬
en: Gained life through the power of evil, he holds a large axe in his hands to defend himself.

zh: 一口銳利的牙齒﹐連骨頭都可以輕易撕碎⚬
en: He has a sharp tooth that can easily tear apart even bones.

zh: 由超惡質的電腦病毒所組成﹐利用電腦為非作歹⚬
en: It is composed of a computer virus of super malicious quality, and uses the computer to commit crimes.

zh: 常在淒黑的森林間﹐出奇不意的發出聲音﹐驚嚇路人⚬
en: It often makes unexpected noises in the dark forest to scare passers-by.

zh: 接觸到它吐出的纏絲﹐馬上就會被纏繞住而無法動彈⚬
en: If it comes into contact with the tangled threads it spits out, it will immediately become entangled and immobilized.

zh: 一張開口就是吃﹐連垃圾都不放過﹐記得千萬別遇見牠⚬
en: Once it opens its mouth, it just eats, and it doesn't even let go of garbage.

zh: 個性樂觀無慮﹐不喜歡戰鬥﹐但絕不容赦擅闖聖地的人⚬
en: He is optimistic and does not like to fight, but he will not allow people who trespass on sacred ground to be pardoned.

zh: 傳說是雷公的後代子孫﹐每當他一打咳就是要打雷了⚬
en: Legend has it that he is a descendant of the thunder god, and whenever he coughs, it's time for thunder.

zh: 身旁的拐杖擁有替人驅除身上的邪靈附身⚬
en: The walking stick beside him has the ability to expel the possession of evil spirits for people.

zh: 每當天象異常時分﹐就能見到他的縱跡了⚬
en: Whenever the sky is abnormal, you can see his vestiges.

zh: 由雷之石修煉而成的雷獸﹐具有可以操縱閃電的力量⚬
en: By the thunder stone cultivated into the thunder beast, with the power to manipulate lightning.

zh: 當他開始揮動手上的兵器時﹐就是有大海嘯的徵兆⚬
en: When he starts to swing the weapon in his hand, it is a sign of the great tsunami.

zh: 頭上的角一凝聚能量﹐就會發出一道強大的電波⚬
en: The horn on the head, once the energy gathered, will also send a powerful electric wave.

zh: 據說在很久以前﹐戰爭發生的時候﹐他便會從天而降⚬
en: It is said that in the long ago, when the war occurred, he will fall from the sky.

zh: 由堅硬的鋼鐵組成﹐身上的閃電標誌是最大的特徵⚬
en: Made of hardened steel, the lightning symbol on his body is the biggest feature.

zh: 身上會自動凝聚大氣中的電分子﹐藉此電力而發光⚬
en: The body will automatically gather the electric molecules in the atmosphere and glow with the electricity.

zh: 非常有靈性的犬類﹐全身泛著紫藍色的神祕電光⚬
en:
This spiritual dog

glows bright with

a blue aura.
notes: Very spiritual canine, the whole body glowing purple-blue mysterious light.

zh: 雖然是機械製造而成﹐但見鼠類就會猛追不捨⚬
en: Although it is made of machinery, it will chase after rodents when it sees them.

zh: 外貌看起來像貓﹐實際上是一隻非常機智的小老虎⚬
en: Appearance looks like a cat, but in fact is a very smart little tiger.

zh: 忠誠度很高的怪獸﹐能夠忠實地完成主人交代的任務⚬
en: He is a very loyal monster and can faithfully complete the tasks given by his master.

zh: 全身所散發出的氣質深受人們的喜愛﹐喜歡聽讚揚的話⚬
en: He is very popular with people and likes to hear praise.

zh: 穿越時空到處都曾出現過他的身影﹐是上古時代的人類⚬
en: He has appeared everywhere through time and space and is a human from the ancient times.

zh: 一生就是在找尋戰鬥的對象﹐彷彿總是靜不下來⚬
en: All his life he has been looking for an object to fight, as if he can't keep still.

zh: 同時具有雙頭面及擁有雙重性格的特殊怪獸⚬
en: He is a special monster with two heads and two personalities at the same time.

zh: 擁有滑滑黏黏的舌頭﹐最喜歡生活在陰暗潮濕的地方⚬
en: It has a slippery and sticky tongue and likes to live in dark and humid places.

zh: 一生起氣﹐頭上噴出的火燄﹐可將所有的東西燃燒殆盡⚬
en: When he gets angry, the flame coming out of his head can burn up everything.

zh: 可任意模仿各種聲音﹐是忠誠度很高的鳥獸類怪獸⚬
en: It can imitate various sounds at will and is a highly loyal bird-beast-like monster.

zh: 全身被熾熱的火燄包圍著﹐格性也和火燄般激烈粗暴⚬
en: His entire body is surrounded by an exuberant flame, and his personality is as violent as the flame.

zh: 揮動著手上的劍﹐就能不斷落下流星般的火燄⚬
en: With the swing of his sword, he can drop a meteor-like flame.

zh: 會發射出威力強大的火燄﹐使周遭陷入一片火海⚬
en: When he wields his sword, he will shoot out powerful flames that will plunge the surrounding area into a sea of fire.

zh: 年紀尚小的火精靈﹐發起脾氣來﹐威力可不輸給任何人⚬
en: The fire spirit is still young, but when it gets angry, it is as powerful as anyone else.

zh: 火精修練而成的神獸﹐噴出的火焰足以燒掉一座森林⚬
en: The fire spirit is a trained beast that can burn down a forest with its flames.

zh: 傳說是李哪吒隨身配帶的代步工具⚬
en: Legend has it that it is the walking tool that Li Nezha carries with him.

zh: 掌管著大自然的火﹐任何火類的神獸都敬重他三分⚬
en: He is in charge of the fire of nature and is respected by all fire beasts.

zh: 沉睡在深海中的珍珠貝殼裡﹐偶爾會游出水面偷窺人類⚬
en: He sleeps in a pearl shell in the deep sea and occasionally swims out of the water to spy on humans.

zh: 暴風雪出現時才能看見﹐一年只覓食一次﹐其餘時間都在冬眠⚬
en: He can only be seen when a storm occurs, and he only feeds once a year and spends the rest of his time hibernating.

zh: 有著數不完的觸腳﹐特別喜歡吃小孩來充實自已的能量⚬
en: With an endless number of tentacles, especially like to eat children to enrich their energy.

zh: 故意製造大海嘯﹐一但被捲入﹐便成為它的腹中物⚬
en: It deliberately creates tsunami, and once it is swept into it, it will become its belly.

zh: 利用延伸的觸腳攀附在敵人身上﹐吸取其精華至死⚬
en: It uses its extended tentacles to cling to its enemies and suck their essence to death.

zh: 由於皮膚細薄只要遭到日光照射﹐便會提升血液溫度⚬
en: Due to the thin skin, it will raise the blood temperature when exposed to sunlight.

zh: 動作緩慢﹐卻能游數百里而不累的巨型龜類怪獸⚬
en: A giant turtle-like creature that can swim hundreds of miles without getting tired despite its slow movements.

zh: 肚子一發出咕嚕聲﹐就表示牠肚子餓了⚬
en: The sound of its stomach growling indicates that it is hungry.

zh: 平時是安靜在海底沉睡﹐肚子餓時才會張開蚌殼覓食⚬
en: Normally, it sleeps quietly on the ocean floor, but when it is hungry, it will open its clam shell to feed.

zh: 身上的羊毛可以保暖﹐是一種相當溫馴的草食性動物⚬
en: The wool on its body keeps it warm, making it a very docile herbivore.

zh: 擁有強韌的意志力﹐以及甲蟲特有的完美防禦力⚬
en: The beetle has a strong willpower and perfect defensive power.

zh: 性格暴躁、桀桀不馴﹐不容易與人類親近⚬
en: The beetle is irascible, untamed and not easy to get close to humans.

zh: 個性溫和﹐總是笑嘻嘻的﹐喜歡偷窺人們的一舉一動⚬
en: The gentle nature, always smiling, like to spy on people's every move.

zh: 這樣一根根紅色的毛髮﹐據說擁有如稀有金屬的硬度⚬
en: This red hair is said to have the hardness of a rare metal.

zh: 以異常發達的肌肉進行攻擊﹐破壞力相當驚人⚬
en: The attack is carried out with abnormally developed muscles, and the destructive power is quite amazing.

zh: 當靜電氣聚集過多時﹐連表面不受吸力的軟毛也會豎起⚬
en: When too much static electricity is gathered, even the soft hairs that are not subject to suction on the surface will stand up.

zh: 只會盲目地勇往直衝進行破壞﹐因而造成頭上的角彎曲⚬
en: The horn on the head is bent because it will only blindly charge straight ahead to destroy.

zh: 膽小的草性怪獸﹐一遇到害怕的事情﹐就躲進草堆中⚬
en: A timid grass monster that hides in the grass when it encounters something it is afraid of.

zh: 必須轉動發條才能活動﹐頂上改造成像降落傘般飛行功能⚬
en:
It flies with the

parachute atop its

head.
notes: The heart needs to turn the hair bar to move, and the top is transformed into a parachute-like flying function.

zh: 最喜歡擺動著牠那雙翼﹐以美麗的姿態在天空中自由飛翔⚬
en: Most like to swing its wings, to beautiful posture in the sky to fly freely.

zh: 頭腦不怎麼靈光﹐遇到危險時﹐會發出難聽的叫聲⚬
en: It is not very smart, and when it encounters danger, it will make an unpleasant screaming sound.

zh: 相當難看見的怪獸之一﹐一翻動身體很可能造成大地震⚬
en: It is one of the most difficult monsters to see, and when it flips its body, it may cause a big earthquake.

zh: 使用背後的雙翅飛翔於空中﹐不論是地上或空中都能發揮⚬
en: Use the wings behind the back to fly in the air, whether on the ground or in the air can play.

zh: 居住在天上人間的精靈﹐是人見人怕的頑皮鬼⚬
en: The spirit that lives in the sky is a naughty ghost that people are afraid of.

zh: 擁有強力的翅膀和驚人的體力﹐喜歡飛翔在峽谷溪間⚬
en: Have strong wings and amazing physical strength, like to fly in the canyon and stream.

zh: 夜間才會出來行動﹐靠著發光的眼睛找尋獵物⚬
en: Only at night will come out to move, relying on the light of the eyes to find prey.

zh: 飛行時所產生的超音波﹐能令聽到的敵人麻痺⚬
en: The ultrasonic waves generated when flying can paralyze enemies who hear them.

zh: 據說天空中出現的七彩彩虹﹐就是牠所畫的哦
en: It is said that the colorful rainbow that appears in the sky is painted by him.

zh: 身上散發出的咖啡香味﹐會使人興奮不已⚬
en: The scent of coffee emitted from its body will make people excited.

zh: 全身如同鑽石般堅硬﹐可說是無堅不摧⚬
en: The whole body is as hard as diamond, it can be said to be indestructible.

zh: 喜愛全身滾著爛泥巴﹐相當自在地享受著日光浴⚬
en: It likes to be covered with mud and enjoys sunbathing quite comfortably.

zh: 身體的中央被稱之為核心的部分﹐每次攻擊時會射出石頭⚬
en: The center of the body is called the core part, each attack will shoot out stones.

zh: 絕技是利用身上的角﹐在地上像陀螺般的旋轉﹐砍傷敵人⚬
en: The best technique is to use the horns on the body to spin like a gyroscope on the ground and slash the enemy.

zh: 只要被牠握住的東西﹐不到牠斷氣是絕不會放手的⚬
en: As long as it holds something, it will not let go until it breaks.

zh: 經常潛行在地底下﹐不太喜歡拋頭露面⚬
en: It often sneaks under the ground and does not like to show its face.

zh: 當發現獵物時﹐能準確無誤地將獵物捕捉住﹐非常的聰明⚬
en: When it finds prey, it can accurately capture the prey and is very smart.

zh: 據說牠的手上的燈火﹐可以指引亡死的靈魂通往地獄之路⚬
en: It is said that the lamp in its hand can guide the souls of the dead to the road to hell.

zh: 黑暗地獄所派的使者﹐專門勾引邪惡心靈的人類⚬
en: The messenger sent by the dark hell, specializing in seducing the evil-minded human.

zh: 被布所包裹著的身體內到底是什麼﹐至今仍是個謎⚬
en: What is inside the body wrapped in cloth is still a mystery.

zh: 從邪惡的闇黑勢力所衍生出的生物體﹐目前仍在進化中⚬
en: A creature derived from the dark forces of evil that is still evolving.

zh: 攻擊時利用身體將敵人纏繞住﹐讓敵人窒息而死⚬
en: When attacking, they use their bodies to wrap around their enemies and suffocate them to death.

zh: 一付不懷好意的笑容﹐心裡盤算著下一個捉弄的對象⚬
en: He has an unkind smile and is planning his next target.

zh: 攻擊速度相當快﹐能在瞬間奪取對手的性命⚬
en: Attack speed is very fast, can kill the opponent in an instant.

zh: 身體雖小﹐但尾巴上的鏈刀﹐能快速撕裂任何東西⚬
en: Although the body is small, but the chain knife on the tail, can quickly tear anything.

zh: 頭部已完全金屬化﹐可防禦住大部份的攻擊⚬
en: The head has been completely metalized to defend against most attacks.

zh: 擁有任意穿梭在時空隧道的能力﹐甚至是未知的世界⚬
en: Have the ability to travel through time and space tunnels at will, even unknown worlds.

zh: 彈奏出的歌曲﹐讓聽到音樂的人昏昏睡去⚬
en: Play songs that make people who hear the music drift off to sleep.

zh: 會將時間吃掉當成自己的能量﹐使時間靜止不動⚬
en: Will eat time as their own energy, so that time does not move.

zh: 準確的報時能力﹐但看久了可是會被它給搉眠的哦⋯⋯
en: Accurate ability to tell the time, but look at it for a long time, but it will be sure to sleep Oh ......

zh: 性情喜歡使壞﹐會使用帶有雷電的長形光線來進行攻擊⚬
en: Temperament like to make bad, will use with lightning long light to attack.

zh: 眼睛是牠最大的特徵﹐黑暗處也能看得一清二楚的⚬
en: The eyes are its biggest feature, and it can see clearly in the dark.

zh: 天生的好歌喉﹐心情好的時候﹐隨時可以高歌一首⚬
en: The natural good singing voice, when the mood is good throat can sing a song at any time.

zh: 平時生活在地上﹐一旦遇到危險就會藉著飛行逃走⚬
en: Usually lives on the ground, but when it encounters danger, it will escape by flying.

zh: 遨遊於世界的天際之間﹐是神話中的天龍之首⚬
en: He is the head of the dragon in mythology, and travels between the world's skies.

你為什麼會有這
張設計圖﹖
en:
I took a look at those blueprints you gave me, and they're truly wonderful!

These blueprints are for a giant spaceship!

Where could you have gotten these?

name: BALLOT
zh:
這是爸爸唯一留
下的東西⋯⋯

我一直在想﹐
如照著爸爸的
目標走﹐

一定可以相遇的
⚬
en:
This is the only thing my father left behind..

I hoped that by following in his footsteps, I'd figure out where he went.

name: DR_LEO
zh:
是這樣啊﹗

⋯⋯⋯⋯這是什
麼﹖

設計圖的『核』
﹐
怎麼有八個空白
的部份﹖

⋯⋯⋯

慢著⋯或許⋯⋯
en:
Oh, I see...

Wait, what's this?

In the blueprints for the Core, there are 8 missing pieces...

Unless...

name: DR_LEO
zh:
就是這個﹗
『動力晶片』﹗
這是核心的
一部份﹗

就我所知﹐
這晶片共有八
個﹐
分別由八個科學
家保管⚬

喂喂～巴洛特﹗

你不是想找到你
爸爸嗎﹖
我們就來做個分
工：

我負責完成圖上
的太空船機體⚬

你就負責尋找﹐
剩下的七個動力
晶片﹐

好嗎﹖
en:
I've got it!

These sections correspond to the power circuits, which are the most important piece of the core!

As far as I can gather, those chips should be in the possession of 8 scientists, and I have one of them.

Ballot!

You want to find your father, don't you? How about we make a deal?

I'll finish the hull of the spaceship, while you go and hunt down the other 7 chips so that we can make this thing fly.

How about that?

name: BALLOT
zh:
動力晶片﹖

爸爸一定也想解
開這個謎團⚬

好的﹗

雷歐博士～
我答應你⚬
en:
Power circuits?

Dad must have been trying to solve the mystery of these little things.

Alright!

Dr. Leo, it's a deal!

name: 1B
zh:
這個晶片﹖

我好像在董事長
那裡﹐
看過類似的東西
⚬

但董事長發生了
一件令人難過的
事情⋯

一言難盡⋯⋯

巴洛特要是來到
加爾企業﹐
我再幫你引見董
事長⚬

各位﹐再見了⚬
en:
These circuits?

I think I remember the chairman having something like that once, but something unfortunate happened since then...

It's kind of hard to explain...

Ballot, if you come over to Gale Corp, I'll help you make an appointment with the chairman.

I've got to go now, see you!

name: DR_LEO
zh:
你不是想找到你
爸爸嗎﹖
我們就來做個分
工：

我負責完成圖上
的太空船機體⚬

你就負責尋找﹐
剩下的七個動力
晶片⚬
en:
You want to find your father, don't you?

I'll finish the hull of the spaceship, so go and hunt down the other 7 chips so that we can make this thing fly.

name: DR_LEO
zh:
巴洛特～
慢著慢著﹗

先不要急著走⚬
en: Ballot, hold on! Don't leave in such a hurry!

name: DR_LEO
zh:
這個給你﹗

這是晶片追蹤器
及傳送ＰＤＡ⚬

有了它﹐就可以
知道﹐
剩餘晶片的所在
位置了﹗

ＰＤＡ則是方便
你～
將得到的晶片﹐
傳輸給我⚬
en:
This is for you!

It's a tracker to help you find the circuits, along with a PDA.

With this, you can find out where all the chips are!

The PDA will be convenient as well: you can use it to send the diagrams you find to me.

name: BALLOT
zh: 得到了追蹤器﹗

name: BALLOT
zh: 得到了ＰＤＡ﹗

name: DR_LEO
zh:
巴克～

你也跟著巴洛特
吧﹗

多個人﹐也好彼
此照應⚬
en:
Buck, why don't you go with Ballot?

With more people in the party, it'll be safer for him to travel.

name: BUCK
zh:
博士．巴克．
巴克⋯

name: DR_LEO
zh:
我知道你在想什
麼﹗

等你回來～

我一定想辦法將
你變得像個人類
好嗎﹖
en:
I know what you're thinking!

Once you return safely, I'll figure out something to make you more humanlike!

How about that?

name: BUCK
zh: 博士．真的﹖

name: DR_LEO
zh:
就這樣改一改⋯

就是這裡⋯

⋯⋯⋯

ＯＫ﹗
改造完畢﹗

巴克的新式機械
鳥﹐
將可搭載巴克﹐
飛過小型的凹地
﹗
en:
Just tweak this, and solder that...

OK! The modifications are complete!

Buck, this brand new robot bird is for you!

I've named it Beattro, and it can carry you across small bumps in the road!

name: BALLOT
zh:
巴克＆機械鳥
加入隊伍﹗
en: Buck and Beattro joined the party!

name: SYSTEM
zh:
星獸．機械鳥加
入隊伍⚬

如果將巴克置於
隊伍前頭﹐
可籍由機械鳥的
力量﹐
飛越地圖的小型
凹洞⚬
en: Star Beast Beattro joined the party. If Buck is leading the party, he can use Beattro's power to cross small holes in the ground.

name: DR_LEO
zh:
去吧～

到加爾企業﹐
尋找剩下的七個
動力晶片吧⚬
en: Go on! You can start at GaleCorp, and find the other 7 chips from there.

name: DR_LEO
zh:
去吧～

到加爾企業﹐
尋找剩下的七個
動力晶片吧⚬
en: Go on! You can start at GaleCorp, and find the other 7 chips from there.

name: BALLOT
zh:
這個洞⋯
該怎麼通過呢﹖
en: This hole... How will we cross it?

name: BUCK
zh:
巴洛特．巴克．
換．在排頭⚬

機械鳥．飛．地
洞⚬
en: ＢＡＬＬＯＴ！ ＬＥＴ ＢＵＣＫ ＬＥＡＤ． ＢＥＡＴＴＲＯ ＣＡＮ ＦＬＹ ＯＶＥＲ ＨＯＬＥＳ．

name: BLANK
zh:
加爾企業董可長
找到了孫子﹖

真是替他感到高
興～
en:
Gale Corp.'s chairman's grandson has been found?

I'm so happy for him!

name: BLANK
zh:
往西邊走的話﹐
就是鐘塔了⚬

那是加爾企業董
事長為了紀念去
逝的女兒而建的
那鐘塔已經成為
多魯市的地標了
呢⚬

我們都是依照鐘
塔上的時間座息
的⚬
en: If you go west, you'll see the Clock Tower. The chairman of Gale Enterprises erected it as a memorial to his deceased daughter. It's become a landmark of Dorington, and we all set our watches according to the time on the Clock Tower.

name: BLANK
zh:
真是奇怪﹗真是
奇怪呀﹗

到底什麼事奇怪
呢﹗

我也說不上來⋯
en:
It's weird! It's really weird!

What's so weird? Even I can't tell...

name: BLANK
zh:
嘻嘻～吃點心吃
得好飽喲﹗啊﹗
這⋯這是怎麼回
事﹖好⋯奇⋯怪
﹗
en:
Heehee! I ate so many snacks, I'm full! Ah! 

What's going on? 

This is... so strange!

name: BLANK
zh:
嘻嘻～
吃得好飽喲﹗

name: BLANK
zh:
加爾企業明天就
要舉行董事交接
典禮﹗真是期待
en:
Gale Corp. will be holding a handover ceremony tomorrow!

I'm really looking forward to it.

name: BLANK
zh: 這裡是多魯市⚬
en: Welcome to Dorington, home of the world-famous Gale Enterprises.

name: BLANK
zh:
看到那棟最高的
建築了嗎﹖
那就是鼎鼎大名
的加爾企業唷﹗
en: Do you see that tall tower over there? That building is the headquarters of the famous Gale Enterprises!

name: BLANK
zh:
看過告示版了嗎
﹖真是可憐啊～
加爾企業的董事
長正在尋找十六

年前失散的孫子
呢⚬
en: Do you see that noticeboard? How sad.. Gale Enterprises' chairman is still trying to find his grandchild, who vanished 16 years ago.

name: BLANK
zh:
往西邊走的話﹐
就是鐘塔了⚬
那是加爾企業董
事長為了紀念去
逝的女兒而建的

那鐘塔已經成為
多魯市的地標了

呢⚬我們都是依
照鐘塔上的時間
作息的⚬
en: If you go west, you'll see the Clock Tower. The chairman of Gale Enterprises erected it as a memorial to his deceased daughter. It's become a landmark of Dorington, and we all set our watches according to the time on the Clock Tower.

name: BLANK
zh:
加爾企業董事長
失散的孫子﹐身

上掛著一條會發
光的月型項鍊﹐
名叫月琉璃⚬要
是被我找到的話
﹐我就發財了⚬
en: The grandson of Gale Enterprises' chairman was said to have worn a shiny necklace in the shape of the moon, known as the Moon Glaze. I'm sure it's worth a fortune! If I find it, I'll be rich!

name: BLANK
zh:
哦～鐘塔的時間
已經３點了﹗

嘻嘻～點心時間
到了﹗
en: The time on the clock tower is 3pm! Hehe, it's teatime!

name: BLANK
zh:
唉呀～真是不得
了﹗

只要能找到加爾
企業董事長的孫

子﹐就能獲得一
～大筆錢﹗

我一定要搶在別
人前面找到﹗
en: Aiyeee!! This is serious! If I find the chairman's grandson before anyone else, I'll get a lot of money! I must find him before anyone else does!

name: BLANK
zh: 想知道嗎﹖
en: Do you want to know something?

name: BLANK
zh: 是這樣子的啊～

name: BLANK
zh:
十六年前﹐加爾
企業董事長～
哈爾遜的女兒﹐
與一名牧羊人發
生了戀情⚬

董事長非常的憤
怒﹐覺得牧羊人
高攀不上他的女
兒⚬

於是拆散了二人
﹐並把剛出世的
小嬰兒送走⚬

之後﹐董事長的
女兒便鬱鬱而終
en: 16 years ago, the daughter of Harrison, Gale Enterprises' chairman, had a relationship with a shepherd. The chairman was furious as he felt that the shepherd was not worthy of his daughter, so he forced them to break up and had the child sent away. The chairman's daughter died of depression shortly after.

name: BLANK
zh:
往南邊走﹐就會
到達山達農莊⚬

那裡是個純樸的
小鎮﹐主要出產

咖啡跟天使之葉
⚬
en: If you go south, you will arrive at Mountreach Farm. It is a simple town that produces mainly coffee and angel leaves.

name: BLANK
zh:
真是奇怪﹗真是
奇怪呀﹗

我終於發現奇怪
在哪裡了﹗

鐘塔上的時間﹐
似乎動都不動﹗
是鐘塔出了問題
嗎﹖

會是我的錯覺嗎
﹖
en:
How weird! How very weird! I finally figured out what seemed so strange to me!

The time on the clock tower doesn't seem to advance at all!

Is something wrong with the clock tower?

Or am I imagining things?

name: BLANK
zh:
好⋯奇⋯怪﹗
我才剛吃完點心
﹐怎麼還是３點
呢﹖人家好飽⋯

不要吃了啦﹗
en:
That's sooo weird!

I just finished my snacks, why is it still 3 o'clock?

I'm full... I don't wanna eat anymore!

name: BLANK
zh:
真是奇怪﹗真是
奇怪呀﹗
鐘塔的時間又動
了﹗

看來是我的錯覺
⚬
en:
How strange! How very strange!

The time on the clock tower has started moving again!

Looks like I was imagining things.

name: BLANK
zh:
唉～其實加爾企
業董事長的心情

﹐我真的可以體
會⋯⋯

年老時才發現﹐
沒有人可以繼承

他那龐大的事業
﹐那是相當令人
不甘心的⚬
en: In fact, I really empathise with the chairman of GaleCorp... it is quite disheartening to find out that there is no one to inherit his huge business in old age.

name: BLANK
zh:
哼﹗那個加爾企
業的董事長﹐一
點都不可憐呢﹗

當初他要是沒有
拆散那對戀人的

話﹐就不會有這
種結果了﹗
en: Hmph! I don't pity the chairman at all! If he hadn't broken up the couple in the first place, they wouldn't have ended up like this!

name: BLANK
zh:
十六年前﹐哈爾
遜董事長的女兒
﹐愛上了一名男
人﹗那名牧羊人
﹐就是山達農莊
的牧羊人⚬
事後那名牧羊人
被趕出這裡﹐再
也沒有人看過他
了⋯⋯
en: Sixteen years ago, Chairman Harrison's daughter fell in love with a man! He was a shepherd at Mountreach Farm. The shepherd was later chased out of here and never seen again...

name: BLANK
zh:
你⋯你後面那隻
⋯怪獸⋯
就是爸爸說的星
獸嗎﹖

真可怕﹗﹗
en: That... monster behind you... is that one of the Star Beasts Dad was talking about? It's scary!

name: BLANK
zh:
點心﹗點心﹗
媽媽～點心時間
到了啦﹗哥哥沒
有回來﹐人家要

吃～雙倍喲﹗
en:
Cake! Cake! Mom, it's teatime! 

Brother isn't back yet, so I wanna eat two parts!

name: BLANK
zh:
人家才沒有偷吃
櫃子裡的蛋糕唷
﹗⋯嗚～

被你知道了﹗人
家不是故意的嘛

﹗不可以跟哥哥
說唷﹗

這是我們的小密
祕唷﹗
en: I didn't steal the cake from the cupboard! ⋯You've found me out?! I didn't do it on purpose! Don't tell my brother! It's our little secret!

name: BLANK
zh:
我的老公是鐘塔
的管理人員⚬

每天都要忙到晚
才能回來⚬

真是叫人寂寞啊
⋯⋯
en: My husband is the manager of the clock tower. He has to work late every day. How sad...

name: BLANK
zh:
唉～有機會的話
﹐真想到鄰國做
生意⚬但是本國
和鄰國的關係﹐
一直不是很好⚬

就連來往的通道
都被填平了⋯
唉～～
en: Haiz... I really want to do business overseas. But the relationship between our country and the neighboring ones isn't good. Even the roads have been blocked... Haiz~

name: BLANK
zh:
少爺～這裡就是
東漁市了⚬

祝少爺旅程平安
順利⚬
en:
Young master, this is Dongyu Town.

I hope your journey goes well.

name: BLANK
zh:
這裡是漁港路都
市～東漁市⚬

四周就是比底斯
海了⚬
en:
Welcome to the Dongyu Town, the city of fishing.

We're surrounded by the Deepa Sea.

name: BLANK
zh:
聽說小孩子如果
在海邊玩耍的話

就會被人魚吃掉
哦﹗

媽媽說小龜就是
被人魚吃掉的﹗
en:
It's said that kids that go play at the beach get eaten by mermaids!

That's what mom said happened to Xiaogui!

name: BLANK
zh:
在另外的那一邊
有一個神木村喲

那裡有一棵～
好大～
好大的大樹喲﹗
en: In the Sacred Tree Village, across the sea, there's a super, super big tree!

name: BLANK
zh:
安東的世代都是
海洋科學家⚬

他的祖先﹐也是
八名偉大科學家
的後代喲﹗
en:
Anton's family has worked as marine scientists for generations.

His ancestors also descend from the 8 great scientists!

name: BLANK
zh:
嗚～小龜～
我的兒子啊～
嗚嗚～

小龜被人魚吃掉
了﹗
嗚嗚嗚～
可惡的人魚﹗
en:
Waaah... Xiaogui...

My poor child...

Sniff...

Xiaogui was eaten by mermaids!

Waaah...

These horrible mermaids!

name: BLANK
zh:
最近海邊出現了
人魚﹐而且靠近

海邊的小孩子都
莫名的失蹤了﹗

一定是被人魚吃
掉了﹗
en:
Mermaids have been spotted near the beach lately, and children on the beach have started disappearing for no reason!

The mermaids must have eaten them!

name: BLANK
zh:
前陣子看到安東
的未婚妻～海藍

﹐在海邊與人魚
講話⚬

是我看錯了嗎﹖
我一定要弄清楚
﹗
en:
Some time ago, I saw Anton's fiancee, Helen, talking with a mermaid at the beach.

I wasn't mistaken, was I?

I have to figure this out!

name: BLANK
zh:
唉～自從流星雨
過後﹐天空就出
現了裂縫⚬

咦～那條裂縫好
像愈來愈大了﹗
真叫人不安⚬
en:
Ah... Since the meteor shower, a crack appeared in the sky.

And this crack seems to be getting bigger and bigger!

That's really worrying.

name: BLANK
zh:
這裡是東漁市的
集會廣場⚬
en: This is Dongyu Town's town square.

name: BLANK
zh:
貝殼～挖貝殼～
小小的身體～

小小的家～
啦啦啦啦～
挖挖挖～
en:
Little shell~ Digging little shell!

A tiny lil' guy~

In a tiny lil' house!

La la la la!

Dig, dig, dig!

name: BLANK
zh:
瓜瓜～快回家﹗
海邊很危險﹗
趕快回家﹗
en:
Gua Gua, get back!

The beach is very dangerous!

Hurry back home!

name: HELEN
zh:
你們來做什麼﹖
你們是來帶走安
東的嗎﹖

我永遠都不會原
諒你們的﹗
en:
What are you doing here?

Are you here to take Anton away?

I will never forgive you!

name: BALLOT
zh:
雖然我不懂愛情
但是媽媽以前曾

說過﹐愛一個人
﹐就要給他自由
的空間⚬
不是嗎﹖
en:
I might not get romance, but mom once said that if you love someone, you have to give them freedom.

Isn't that right?

name: HELEN
zh:
住口﹗
你們⋯你們什麼
都不懂﹗

再過不久～
那個時候到了⋯
我就會⋯
我就會⋯⋯

我決不讓安東離
開我﹗
en:
Shut up!

You... You don't understand anything!

Soon, it will be time...

I'll... I'll...

I will never let Anton leave me!

name: BLANK
zh:
瓜瓜﹗
瓜～瓜瓜﹗
怎麼辦﹗
怎麼辦﹗

瓜瓜被人魚捉走
了﹗

誰來救救他﹗
救命啊﹗
en:
Gua Gua!

Gua Guaaa!

Oh no, oh no, what do I do!

Gua Gua is being kidnapped by mermaids!

Somebody, save him!

Save him!

name: BLANK
zh: 糟糕﹗

好⋯好難過⋯⋯
這種感覺⋯⋯
我死了嗎﹖
也好⋯
en:
I feel...

So weak...



This...



Am I dead?



This can't...

name: BALLOT
zh:
這裡是哪裡﹖
我為什麼在這裡
﹖
en:
What is this place?

How did I end up here?

name: 3C
zh:
原來海巫師就是
殺掉人類小孩的

兇手⚬
真是可惡﹗
en:
It turns out that it was the Sea Witch who was killing all the human children.

How horrible!

name: 3B
zh:
嗚嗚嗚～
海青真是可憐⋯

為了海藍﹐犧牲
了自己的生命⋯

那個自私的海藍
﹐要是回來的話

﹐我一定要她賠
命﹗
嗚～海青～
en:
Waaah...

Poor Haiqing...

She sacrificed herself for Helen...

If that selfish Helen ever comes back, I'll make her pay dearly!

Sniff... Haiqing...

name: 3A
zh:
到底是先有烏龜
呢﹐還是先有蛋

﹗還是想不出來
⋯⋯什麼﹖
想回陸地上面﹖
不行哪～

我深奧的沈思還

車的城市⚬

前陣子和二個外
地人比賽﹐
居然輸了﹗

還虧我們派出了
最強的機械科學
家～雷歐應戰﹗

就這樣﹐
科技城輸了三千
萬﹗
en:
This city has the largest racing car manufacturing line in the world.

However, we lost to two foreigners a while ago!

Even though we sent Dr. Leo to the challenge, we still lost 30 million!

name: BLANK
zh:
衝呀﹗

我的高速賽車～
長腳龜一號﹗

只要那些壞人再
來的話﹐
我就用這個打敗
他們﹗
en: Take a look! My high-speed racing car! Tourtega Mk.I! If those scoundrels come again, I'll beat them with this!

name: BLANK
zh:
嗚～嗚～
好黑哦﹗

人家好怕啊﹗


嗚～～嗚～
en: It's so dark! I'm scared! Waah...

name: BLANK
zh:
很久很久之前～

雷歐的曾祖父﹐
和其他七名科學
家﹐
曾經拯救過地球
⚬

所以城裡的人都
尊敬他⚬

但這次的賽車比
賽﹐
雷歐卻輸得很誇
張﹗

我們會不會太高
估他了﹖
en:
A long time ago, Leo's great-

grandfather and seven other scientists saved the Earth, so everyone in this city respects him.

But in this race, Leo lost by a huge margin!

Are we over-

estimating him?

name: BLANK
zh:
這裡是科技城的
廢鐵集中場⚬

別看這些破破爛
爛的東西﹐
這些全是我的寶
貝﹗
en: This is our scrapyard. They may look like pieces of junk, but to me, they're treasure!

name: BLANK
zh:
雷歐博士已經上
了年紀﹐
又沒有小孩子⚬

所以製造了一隻
叫巴克的機器人

是我的錯覺嗎﹖

每次一看到巴克
﹐
就覺得他很憂鬱
⋯⋯
en:
Dr. Leo is aging, yet he has no children.

So, he built a robot named Buck.

Is it just me, or is it that every time I see Buck, I get the feeling that he is somewhat depressed...

name: BLANK
zh:
科技城是座室內
都市﹐
照明的設備都需
要電力來驅動⚬

可是﹐
為了要防止類似
這種形情發生﹐
電力塔內設有特
殊防範措施啊﹗

真是奇怪⋯
en:
Tech City is an enclosed town, and all our lights are electric lights.

But there are special precautions in the power station to prevent situations like this from happening!

How odd...

name: BLANK
zh:
雷歐代表科技城
和閃電隊賽車﹐
輸了三千萬﹗

為了籌這三千萬
﹐
真是急死人了﹗

早知道就不應該
派雷歐上場的⋯
en:
Leo lost ¥30 million racing against Team Volt on behalf of Tech City!

Now I have no idea where to get the ¥30 million from!

I should have known better than to send Dr. Leo out in the field...

name: BLANK
zh:
哼﹗

小毛用他的長腳
龜一號欺負人家

人家才不要﹗﹗

爸爸～
好不好啦～
爸爸～

幫人家改裝這台
粉紅豬三號啦﹗
en:
Hmph! Hairy's been bullying people with Tourtega Mk.I!

Dad, please help me modify Pippo Mk.III to stop him!

name: BLANK
zh:
要大家湊這三千
萬﹐
真是開玩笑﹗

把這個藏起來～

荳荳﹗
那個也是﹗

呀﹗﹗
你看到了什麼嗎
﹖

我什麼都沒有做
唷﹗
en:
What a joke!

They're asking everyone to chip in to cover the ¥30 million they lost!

Hide this!

That one too! Yeah!

Did you see anything? There's nothing here, buddy!

name: BLANK
zh:
真是傷腦筋﹐
莫名的停電⚬
看不到星獸的後
續新聞報導了⚬

話說回來了﹐
博特到電塔修理
了那麼久﹐
怎麼還沒有回來
呢﹖
en:
This inexplicable power outage has been a real pain!

I can't see the follow-up news reports on the Star Beast incidents.

By the way, why hasn't Burt come back from his trip to the power plant to fix the outage?

name: 1D
zh:
媽媽﹖

荳荳這台光速美
少女初號機﹐
要不要藏起來﹖

荳荳的光速美少
女初號機﹐
價值９４５６億
喲﹗
en:
Mom? Do you want to hide Dot's machine too?

It goes at the speed of light! It's probably worth ¥9456 billion!

name: BLANK
zh: 不．用﹗

name: 1D
zh:
荳．荳．要．藏
．起．來．啦﹗

name: BLANK
zh:
城裡停電了﹐
我兒子～博特到
發電塔修去了﹗

去了好久﹐
都沒有回來﹗

真是擔心啊⋯⋯
en:
The power's gone out, and my son, Burt, went to the power plant to fix it!

He's been gone for quite a while and I'm worried about him...

zh:
真是麻煩﹗

沒有電了﹐
電子收銀台沒辦
法使用⋯

你要什麼嗎﹖
不要趁黑偷東西
喲﹗
en:
What a hassle!



There is no electricity, the electronic cash register can't be used...



What do you want? Don't steal in the dark!

zh:
需要妮可治療嗎
﹖

name: 1A
zh:
這裡是星獸膠囊
存放銀行⚬

需要艾娜的服務
嗎﹖
en: This is the Star Beast Storage Bank. Do you need my help?

name: 1B
zh:
怎麼辦～

怎麼辦～

流星雨打斷了回
多魯市的道路﹗

身為加爾企業採
購部經理的我﹐
必需要趕回去開
個重要會議﹗

雷歐博士～
你要想想辦法啊
﹗
en:
What to do? What to do?

The meteor shower wrecked the road back to Dorington!

As the manager of the procurement department of GaleCorp, I cannot be late for my important meeting!

Dr. Leo, you have to do something!

name: DR_LEO
zh:
唉～
都是我的錯～

讓科技城輸了三
千萬﹐
還賠上了高速賽
車之都的名譽⋯
en: Alas, thanks to me, Tech City has not only lost 30 million yen, but it's also lost its reputation as the capital of high-speed racing.

name: BALLOT
zh:
雷歐博士﹐
你就是伊隼人所
說的﹐
天才機械發明家
～雷歐博士嗎﹖

可不可以請您看
看這張設計圖﹗
en:
Dr. Leo, are you the genius mechanical inventor that Hayato was talking about?

Could you take a look at this blueprint?

name: DR_LEO
zh:
設計圖⋯
放著吧～

我代表著科技城
﹐
和閃電隊比賽迷
你賽車﹗

居然輸了⋯

我不甘心⋯

我的黃金鳳凰號
竟然⋯

我還有什麼面子
待在這裡⋯⋯
en:
A blueprint? Forget it!

My own Golden Phoenix couldn't beat the Volts in a race...

I'm too ashamed to be called a genius!

name: DR_LEO
zh:
你是指設計圖嗎
﹖

我不是說過﹐

就這樣放著嗎﹖

唉～
我不是機械天才
⋯⋯

而這樣的亮度﹐
無法看到圖裡畫
的究竟是什麼⋯

唉～
之所以會輸﹐
也不完全是我的
錯⋯⋯
en:
What is it?

Didn't I tell you to forget about asking me to read the blueprint?

I'm hardly worthy to be called a mechanical genius... and in the darkness, it's impossible to read the diagram anyway.

...If it wasn't for that, I might not have lost...

name: BLANK
zh:
哦～呵呵呵﹗

哦哦哦～
呵呵呵呵﹗

name: BLANK
zh:
怎麼樣﹖
賴帳的傢伙﹖
en: What's up, my friend? Got the moolah yet?

name: DR_LEO
zh:
他們又來了﹗

我沒有面子再見
其他村人了﹗

你幫我去外面的
『廣場』看看

好嗎﹖
en:
Here they come again!

I'm too ashamed to see the other citizens!

Can you go to the square outside and see what's happening?

name: BLANK
zh:
比賽的承諾～
三千萬﹗

在下這就來取了
﹗
en:
The promised prize money...

My 30 million yen! I'm coming to get it!

name: 1D
zh:
爸爸﹖
他們是誰啊﹖

name: BLANK
zh:
哦～呵呵呵～

我聽到了﹗

你在問我們是誰
嗎﹖
en:
Ohoho! I heard that!

Did you ask who we were?

name: BLANK
zh:
既然你們問起了
～
那我就仁慈的告
訴你們吧﹗
en: Since you've asked so nicely, we'll tell you, out of the kindness of our hearts!

name: BLANK
zh:
來自銀河系裡的
正義使者﹗
en: Messengers of justice, from the Milky Way!

name: BLANK
zh:
穿梭於黑夜的
浪漫勇士﹗
en: Dashing heroes, in both night and day!

name: BLANK
zh:
貫徹愛．正義．
勇氣的真理﹗
en: With truth, justice, courage and love!

name: LAKI
zh: 拉琪﹗

name: KULU
zh: 庫魯﹗

name: LAKI
zh:
閃．電．隊～
～誕生﹗﹗
en: Witness the birth of the Volts!

name: KULU
zh:
還不打算交出三
千萬嗎﹖

現在只是停一下
小電作為懲戒﹗

再不交出來﹐
在下只好將發電
塔爆破﹗
en:
Still not handing over the cash?

We've only temporarily shut down the power as a warning!

If you don't hand it over, we'll be forced to blow up the power plant!

name: LAKI
zh:
哦～呵呵呵～

就是這個鈕﹗
只要輕輕按一下
唷～
發電塔就會～
『磅』唷﹗
en:
Look at this remote control!

Just one push, and the building will go boom, yo!

name: BLANK
zh:
千萬不要這麼做
﹗

name: BUCK
zh:
你們．贏．才怪
﹗

雷歐博士．出了
．問題﹗

你們．才怪．贏
﹗
en: ＴＨＥＲＥ＇Ｓ ＮＯ ＷＡＹ ＹＯＵ ＣＯＵＬＤ ＨＡＶＥ ＷＯＮ！ ＤＲ． ＬＥＯ ＨＡＤ ＩＳＳＵＥＳ ＰＲＯＣＵＲＩＮＧ Ａ ＰＡＲＴ． Ｉ＇Ｍ ＳＵＲＥ ＹＯＵ ＣＨＥＡＴＥＤ！

name: KULU
zh:
在下認得你﹗

你不就是那個手
下敗將～
雷歐的機器人嗎
﹖
en:
Wait, I know you!

You're the robot made by that guy we beat!

Dr. Leo, wasn't it?

name: BUCK
zh:
胡說﹗

再比．雷歐博士
．一定贏﹗
en:
ＩＭＰＯＳＳＩＢＬＥ！

ＤＲ． ＬＥＯ ＷＯＵＬＤ ＳＵＲＥＬＹ ＷＩＮ Ａ ＲＥＭＡＴＣＨ！

name: LAKI
zh:
哦哦～呵呵呵﹗

沒有那個的話﹐
再比幾次都是一
樣的﹗

算了～

再給你一次機會
好了﹗

三天後再比賽一
場⚬

如果輸的話﹐
就要乾脆的交出
三千萬⚬

哦哦哦哦哦～
～呵呵呵呵﹗
en:
Ohohohoho! Without that thing, he'll never beat us, regardless of how many times he tries!

How about this: We'll give you another chance!

In 3 days, we'll have another race.

If you lose, you'll have to cough up the 30 million bucks. Ohohoho!!

name: BLANK
zh:
雷歐又要和閃電
隊比賽一次了﹗

唉～
看上次那種慘狀
﹗

我們還是想辦法
籌出三千萬好了
en:
Huh? Dr. Leo's racing Team Volt again?!

Considering what happened last time, I think it'd be easier for us to just find a way to raise the 30 million ourselves...

name: BUCK
zh:
再比賽．雷歐博
士．贏．一定﹗
en: ＤＲ． ＬＥＯ ＷＩＬＬ ＷＩＮ ＴＨＥ ＲＥＭＡＴＣＨ！

name: 0A
zh: 恰比～恰比比～

name: DR_LEO
zh:
再比賽一次嗎﹖
實在沒有太大的
把握⋯

因為在不久前﹐
高速賽車零件中
﹐
最高級的彩虹水
晶﹐
莫名奇妙的停產
了﹗沒有那使用那個
當作核心的話﹐
是贏不了的⚬
en:
You want me to race against Team Volt again?

I'm not sure I stand a chance as it is...

Not too long ago, one of the most important car parts, the Rainbow Crystal, was inexplicably discontinued.

Without a Rainbow Crystal for my engine core, I stand no chance of winning.

name: BUCK
zh:
巴克．拿．
彩虹水晶﹗
en: ＢＵＣＫ ＷＩＬＬ ＧＯ ＴＯ ＲＥＴＲＩＥＶＥ ＴＨＥ ＲＡＩＮＢＯＷ ＣＲＹＳＴＡＬ！

name: BALLOT
zh:
為什麼彩虹水晶
會停產﹖

name: DR_LEO
zh:
我也不清楚⋯

水晶村就這樣莫
名停產彩虹水晶
en: I don't know... Crystal Town just stopped producing them one day for no reason.

name: BALLOT
zh:
這其中一定有問
題﹗

我一定要弄清楚
﹗
en: This can't be right.. I'll head over there and check it out!

name: BUCK
zh: 巴克．一起去﹗

name: DR_LEO
zh:
這不是彩虹水晶
嗎﹖

真是太好了﹗

等等～
這就把黃金鳳凰
號的核心換掉⚬
en:
Isn't this a rainbow crystal? That's great!

Now I can make a new core for the Golden Phoenix!

name: DR_LEO
zh:
完成了﹗

真．黃金鳳凰號
﹗

有了這個﹐
就一定可以打敗
閃電隊了﹗
en:
It's done!

The True Golden Phoenix!

With this, I can definitely defeat the Volts!

name: BALLOT
zh:
嗯﹐一定可以的
⚬

name: DR_LEO
zh:
⋯⋯⋯

有了上次輸了的
陰影⋯
我還是不敢⋯⋯

你就拿我的～
真．黃金鳳凰號
和閃電隊比賽吧

⋯⋯
en:
...

The shadow of my former loss still haunts me.

I don't dare to try again, so will you take the True Golden Phoenix and go in my stead to battle Team Volt?

name: BALLOT
zh: 得到鳳凰號﹗

name: DR_LEO
zh:
⋯⋯⋯

有了上次輸了的
陰影⋯
我還是不敢⋯⋯

你就拿我的～
真．黃金鳳凰號
和閃電隊比賽吧

⋯⋯
en:
...

The shadow of my former loss still haunts me.

I don't dare to try again, so will you take the True Golden Phoenix and go in my stead to battle Team Volt?

name: LAKI
zh:
哦～呵呵呵～

你們終於來了⚬

name: KULU
zh:
在下還以為﹐
你們夾著尾巴逃
走了﹗

即使沒有勝算﹐
還是要比嗎﹖
en:
We thought you'd turned tail and fled!

Do you still want to battle us, knowing you don't stand a chance?

name: LAKI
zh:
哦哦哦哦～
呵呵呵呵﹗

三千萬就要到手
了﹗

夢想就要實現了
﹗
en:
Ehehehehehe!

I can almost feel the crisp 30 million yen in my hands!

It's a dream come true!

name: KULU
zh:
還是不甘心敗在
在下的手中嗎﹖

反正再幾次都一
樣⚬
en:
Still not content to quit and save the effort?

This won't change anything, you know!

name: LAKI
zh:
哦～呵呵呵～

我就展現高貴的
耐心﹐
再給你們一次機
會吧﹗
en: Ehehehe~ I'm not usually this patient, but just this once, I'll give you another chance!

name: KULU
zh:
在下⋯輸了﹖

不⋯不可能﹗

name: BLANK
zh:
萬歲﹗

雷歐的鳳凰號果
然贏了﹗

我早就說過﹐
雷歐才是最厲害
的發明家﹗
en:
Hooray! Those dastardly Volts have lost!

I knew it all along: Dr Leo is the best inventor in the world!

name: BALLOT
zh:
哈哈哈～

那三千萬的賭金
﹐
就這麼算了吧﹗
en: Hahaha! You won't have to worry about that 30 million yen anymore!

name: BUCK
zh:
⋯巴克．不能．
笑⋯⋯

巴克⋯⋯想⋯⋯
笑⋯⋯
en:
ＢＵＣＫ ＣＡＮＮＯＴ ＬＡＵＧＨ．．．

ＢＵＣＫ ＷＡＮＴＳ ＴＯ ＬＡＵＧＨ．．．

name: LAKI
zh:
慢⋯慢⋯慢⋯
慢著著著著﹗﹗

我還有最後的終
極祕密武器﹗

就是這個按鈕﹗
en:
H.. HOLD IT!

I still have one last trick up my sleeve!

Remember this remote?

name: KULU
zh:
在下真是佩服拉
琪的智慧⚬

只要輕輕這麼一
按～

一按哦﹗
en:
Laki, you genius!

Just one little press, and...!

name: LAKI
zh:
沒．有．錯﹗

哦～呵呵呵呵～

就會『磅』的一
下唷﹗

不管如何﹐
你們還是準備
三千萬吧﹗
en:
That's right!

Your precious power plant goes boom!

You'd better hand over that 30 million anyway!

name: BLANK
zh:
雷歐博士終於打
敗了閃電隊﹗

我們之前都錯怪
他了⚬
en:
Dr Leo finally defeated the Volts!

We shouldn't have doubted him.

name: BLANK
zh:
這裡是全世界最
大的製作高速賽
車的城市⚬
en: This city has the largest racing car manufacturing line in the world.

name: BLANK
zh:
很久很久之前﹐
雷歐的曾祖父和
其他七名科學家
曾經拯救過地球
⚬

所以城裡的人都
尊敬他⚬
en:
A long time ago, Leo's great-

grandfather and seven other scientists saved the Earth, so everyone in this city respects him.

name: BLANK
zh:
雷歐博士果然是
世界第一的機械
發明家⚬
en: Dr Leo is certainly the best inventor in the world.

name: BLANK
zh:
糟糕⋯

我的水藍鑽石項
鍊﹐
藏到哪裡去了﹖
en: Darn it... Where did my diamond necklace go?

name: 1D
zh:
荳荳這台光速美
少女初號機﹐
找到一個藍色石
頭⚬

光速美少女初號
機～～
使用價值９４５
６億的粉碎鑽頭

粉碎藍色石頭﹗
en: Dot's lightspeed machine found a diamond, and it used its drill (worth ¥9456 billion) to crush it to pieces!

name: DR_LEO
zh:
哈哈哈～

果然打敗了閃電
隊﹗

但是發電塔還是
被佔領了﹗
一定要想辦法解
放發電塔才行⚬

巴洛特﹐
就麻煩你到發電
塔﹐
去察看停電的原
因吧﹗
en:
Hahaha, so you beat the Volts! Well done!

The power's still out, though..

Ballot, could I ask another favour of you?

Can you go to the power plant and investigate why?

zh:
喵嗚～嗚⚬

ｚＺ～ｚＺ～

name: BALLOT
zh:
不行﹗

整個入口都被貓
怪擋住了﹗

得回去向博士報
告才行﹗

Oh no! The entrance's been blocked by this monstrous cat!

有了﹗

I've got it! We can use a robot rat to distract him!

How frustrating!

As a last resort, I'll have to make it spring-powered.

Even though it would be embarrasing for me to make clockwork rats..

Give me a bit, and I'll find the parts I need..

糟糕～

製做發條的機械
製品﹐

了﹗

﹗

Darn it! I used to think that making clockworks was below me, so I threw all those parts out.

Sorry, Ballot, but I need some springs!

得找到發條才行
⚬

﹖

Springs?

Where did I put it...?

Ah, today's weather sure is nice, but dark clouds are gathering...

⋯⋯

就在這些寶貝堆
裡﹐

Ah, right! The spring!

I forgot where I put it, so feel free to search in these piles of treasure!

name: BLANK
zh:
發條﹖

我忘了放哪裡了
⋯⋯

How em- barrassing.. I'll just have to bite the bullet and do it.

Here's the clockwork rat.

I still feel ashamed of resorting to such simple tech...

Ballot! You'd better not tell anyone I made it!

得到了發條老鼠
﹗

zh:

發電塔的貓怪了

嗚嗚～

zh:
啊﹗

發條的動力用完
了⋯

嗚～喵吼喵吼吼
﹗

Miao~ Miao!!!

況⚬

Oh, thank you! After the outage in Tech City, I rushed over to investigate the cause.

Eheheheh~!

zh:
你你⋯你⋯你

Y-y-yo-you?!

zh:
可可⋯可
⋯可惡﹗

這次在下就放了

We'll let you go this time!

Truth, justice and courage: Team Volt, out!

嗎﹖

﹐

真是相當的感謝
⚬

The electricity is back, so I have a pile of documents to work on..

I'm very busy, so is there anything you need?

加重要的會議了

巴洛特啊﹗
你來的剛剛好﹗

﹗

AAAAAAAHHH!!

Ballot! You're right on time!

There's been a major breakthrough!

zh: 了不起的發現﹖

圖﹐
這可是不得了的
東西喲﹗

這可是一台超越
想像的太空船﹗
太．空．船．哦
﹗

你為什麼會有這
張設計圖﹖

I took a look at those blueprints you gave me, and they're truly wonderful!

These blueprints are for a giant spaceship!

Where could you have gotten these?

zh:
這是爸爸唯一留
下的東西⋯⋯

我一直在想﹐
如照著爸爸的
目標走﹐

一定可以相遇的
⚬
en:
This is the only thing my father left behind..

I hoped that by following in his footsteps, I'd figure out where he went.

name: DR_LEO
zh:
是這樣啊﹗

⋯⋯⋯⋯這是什
麼﹖

設計圖的『核』
﹐

⋯⋯⋯

慢著⋯或許⋯⋯

Oh, I see...

Wait, what's this?

In the blueprints for the Core, there are 8 missing pieces...

Unless...

name: DR_LEO
zh:
就是這個﹗
『動力晶片』﹗
這是核心的
一部份﹗

就我所知﹐
這晶片共有八
個﹐
分別由八個科學
家保管⚬

喂喂～巴洛特﹗

你不是想找到你
爸爸嗎﹖
我們就來做個分
工：

我負責完成圖上
的太空船機體⚬

你就負責尋找﹐
剩下的七個動力
晶片﹐

好嗎﹖
en:
I've got it!

These sections correspond to the power circuits, which are the most important piece of the core!

As far as I can gather, those chips should be in the possession of 8 scientists, and I have one of them.

Ballot!

You want to find your father, don't you? How about we make a deal?

I'll finish the hull of the spaceship, while you go and hunt down the other 7 chips so that we can make this thing fly.

How about that?

name: BALLOT
zh:
動力晶片﹖

爸爸一定也想解
開這個謎團⚬

好的﹗

雷歐博士～
我答應你⚬

Power circuits?

Dad must have been trying to solve the mystery of these little things.

Alright!

Dr. Leo, it's a deal!

zh:
這個晶片﹖

我好像在董事長
那裡﹐
看過類似的東西
⚬

一件令人難過的
事情⋯

一言難盡⋯⋯

巴洛特要是來到
加爾企業﹐
我再幫你引見董
事長⚬

各位﹐再見了⚬

These circuits?

I think I remember the chairman having something like that once, but something unfortunate happened since then...

It's kind of hard to explain...

Ballot, if you come over to GaleCorp, I'll help you make an appointment with the chairman.

I've got to go now, see you!

name: DR_LEO
zh:
你不是想找到你
爸爸嗎﹖
我們就來做個分

You want to find your father, don't you?

I'll finish the hull of the spaceship, so go and hunt down the other 7 chips so that we can make this thing fly.

巴洛特～
慢著慢著﹗

先不要急著走⚬

這個給你﹗

這是晶片追蹤器
及傳送ＰＤＡ⚬

傳輸給我⚬

This is for you!

It's a tracker to help you find the circuits, along with a PDA.

With this, you can find out where all the chips are!

The PDA will be convenient as well: you can use it to send the diagrams you find to me.

name: BALLOT
zh: 得到了追蹤器﹗

name: BALLOT
zh: 得到了ＰＤＡ﹗

zh:
巴克～

你也跟著巴洛特

多個人﹐也好彼
此照應⚬

Buck, why don't you go with Ballot?

With more people in the party, it'll be safer for him to travel.

zh:
博士．巴克．
巴克⋯

好嗎﹖

I know what you're thinking!

Once you return safely, I'll figure out something to make you more humanlike!

How about that?

龜一號欺負人家

爸爸～

Hmph! Hairy's been bullying people with Tourtega Mk.I!

Dad, please help me modify Pippo Mk.III to stop him!

衝呀﹗

我的高速賽車～
長腳龜一號﹗

只要那些壞人再

我就用這個打敗
他們﹗

很久很久之前﹐
雷歐的曾祖父和
其他七名科學家
曾經拯救過地球
⚬

所以城裡的人都
尊敬他⚬

A long time ago, Leo's great-

grandfather and seven other scientists saved the Earth, so everyone in this city respects him.

雷歐博士已經上
了年紀﹐

叫巴克的機器人

每次一看到巴克
﹐

⋯⋯

Dr. Leo is aging, yet he has no children.

So, he built a robot named Buck.

Is it just me, or is it that every time I see Buck, I get the feeling that he is somewhat depressed...

name: BLANK
zh:
科技城是座室內
都市﹐
照明的設備都需
要電力來驅動⚬

可是﹐
為了要防止類似
這種形情發生﹐
電力塔內設有特
殊防範措施啊﹗
